newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were little changed in moderate trade on Wednesday, dealers said.
Most traders were waiting for fresh clues to market direction from tonight's release of the U.S. June new home sales figures.

"Rates were steady to a little bit higher in the morning on some position adjustments. The market is waiting for tonight's release of the (U.S. June) new home sales figures, for more clues to market direction," a local dealer said.
"But I don't think there will be much impact unless the numbers are way off market expectations," he said.
In day-to-day rates, Wednesday/Thursday was unchanged at 5-11/16 5-9/16 percent, Thursday/Friday rose 1/18 percentage point to 5-13/16 5-11/16 and week-fixed was unchanged at 5-5/8 5-1/2 percent.

Among longer dates, one-month was unchanged at 5-5/8 5-1/2 percent, three-months unchanged at 5-11/16 5-9/16, nine-months unchanged at 5-7/8 5-3/4 and twelve-months unchanged at 5-15/16 5-13/16 percent.
